title: AI Cat Generator
summary: Free AI cat generator: make pictures and short videos of any cat, invented or your own from a photo, as a photo, cartoon, anime, claymation or watercolour.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI cat generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every cat picture on this page, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.


### How do I make an AI picture of my own cat?


Add a clear, well lit photo of your cat as a reference image, then describe the new picture and name the marks that must stay, such as its coat pattern, eye colour and any white patches.


### How do I make an AI cat look realistic?


Describe it like a real photo: the coat and eye colour, natural fur texture, one real light source such as window light, and a camera, such as a casual smartphone photo with sharp focus on the eyes.


### Can I make a cartoon or anime cat?


Yes. Name the style in the prompt, such as a 3D cartoon, 1990s cel anime, claymation or watercolour, or pick a style once, and the same cat is drawn in that look.


### Can I make a video of a cat with AI?


Yes. Use a cat picture or a photo of your cat as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one simple movement, such as a yawn, a stretch or a tail swish, with the camera still.


### Can I keep the same cat across many pictures?


Yes. Add your first picture or a photo of your cat as a reference image to each new prompt; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images, so you can add a few angles of one cat.


### Can I put several cats in one picture?


Yes. Describe each cat by its own coat colour and place in the frame, such as a cream kitten on the left and a black kitten on the right, so the model keeps them apart.
